messages:
leo (sales): FYI ACME running a full dataset ingest for the POC; seeing 429s and timeouts starting ~08:10 PT. They're blocked for the customer demo later. @erin @noah can you triage?
maya (ACME): Upload jobs hang at 30-40% then most workers report 429s. Request id e3a9c1f2 in logs. No other errors.
erin (eng): What's their client concurrency and batch size? Any proxies or retries?
leo (sales): Maya says they use 12 parallel workers, batch size ~400, no gzip. They sweet spot tuned for throughput.
erin (eng): That pattern usually trips the per-route token rate + concurrent inflight gates on /v1/embeddings. The large batches multiply token-equivalents.
erin (eng): Can you paste the raw response headers when it happens?
maya (ACME): Got one: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: e3a9c1f2
x-rate-limit-limit: 8000
x-rate-limit-remaining: 2
x-rate-limit-reset: 2634501400
body: {"error":"rate limit","code":"route_token_quota_exhausted"}
noah (sre): 'route_token_quota_exhausted' confirms route-level token accounting hit. Short-term: advise client to reduce parallelism to 3-4 and lower batch size to 128-256. Add exponential backoff (500ms -> 4s) with jitter.
leo (sales): ACME team prefers not to change client for the demo. Can we do a temporary bump?
noah (sre): We can do a soft per-tenant bump for demo windows. Need approvals from solutions for cost and note in audit log. This is non-prod-safe but ok for presales.
zoe (solutions): Fine for up to 6 hours. Need estimate of cost delta and we must flag finance/account. Will also update the presales checklist.
erin (eng): Quick estimate: current ingress ~2.5M token-eq/hr; with 12 workers and 400 batch, projected ~5M. Recommend bump +2M token-eq/hr. Ballpark hosted delta ~$200/hr. I'll stage a canary change to acme-eu1 route limiter and monitor.
leo (sales): Schedule canary now; demo at 13:00 PT. Also share rollback plan.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for tenant acme-eu1 (route_tokens +2M/hr).
deploy-bot: canary started; health checks running.
deploy-bot: canary health checks OK (3/3).
maya (ACME): Re-running import with original client (12 workers, 400 batch) — looks green so far, throughput stable. No 429s after 6 minutes.
noah (sre): Monitoring metrics: route token burn under new bucket, latency stable, no error spike. Will note the tenant config change in audit log.
zoe (solutions): Cost estimate sent to finance, CC'd account exec. Also added item to presales playbook: quick mitigations for embeddings POCs (concurrency, batch size, compression, temp bump process).
erin (eng): Revert scheduled in 4 hours unless ACME requests extension. Revert wil include brief 30m warning.
maya (ACME): Demo completed successfully. Thanks everyone!
leo (sales): Closing thread. Tagging internal followups: update demo runbook, capture ACME consent for bump, and confirm billing notification sent. :tada:
